d: The Assistant Store Manager will support in driving sales performance, delivering exceptional customer service, and overseeing daily store operations. The role involves leading and motivating the team, ensuring operational excellence, and maintaining high standards of store presentation.

The ideal candidate will be customer-focused, commercially driven, and passionate about team development, with the ability to enhance customer loyalty and contribute to the overall success of the store.
Support the Store Manager in achieving sales targets, KPIs, and profitability objectives.
Lead, motivate, train, and develop store employees to maximize performance.
Deliver exceptional customer service and enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Oversee daily store operations, stock management, and inventory control.
Maintain store presentation, visual merchandising, and brand standards.
Monitor team performance and support continuous improvement.
Ensure compliance with company policies, operational procedures, and safety standards.
Minimum 3 years of retail experience, preferably in a supervisory or management role.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
Customer-centric with a positive and proactive attitude.
Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage store operations.
Ability to work flexible retail hours, including weekends and holidays.
We are currently looking for dynamic and self-motivated Front Office professionals who want to move their careers forward.
As a Front Desk Agent you are responsible to provide professional and customer focused service to our guests, ensuring their stay will become a memorable experience.
q: You should ideally have a degree in hospitality with previous experience in the Front Office Department within a hotel. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and knowledge in an additional language, along with strong interpersonal and problem-solving abilities are essential. Computer literate and previous experience with Opera are an advantage.
The ideal candidate will be customer driven and an extremely proactive and "switched on" personality with an outgoing, charismatic and approachable character.

You will work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment and be a great team player, who thrives in working with a multicultural team and guests alike, while possessing the following additional competencies
r: Provide prompt, courteous and efficient service to all guest, so as to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction through personalized service from arrival till departure
Ensure guests are personally greeted by name, if known and escorted to their room to make them feel expected and welcomed
Conduct in room hotel familiarization and assist guest in hotel activity enquiries requests
Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of hotel information and local services, including operating hours, promotions, events, attractions and any allied information to respond to guest queries
Maintain an awareness of rate levels to be sold on a daily basis and the occupancy levels
Accurately administer Front Desk cashiering standards and comply with all laid down systems, policies and procedures
Process accounts from check in to check out, ensuring accurate postings of all incidental charges using computerized Front Office systems
Maintain the privacy of all guests by ensuring that no details of the guests are disclosed
Demonstrate a complete understanding of the hotel's policies, procedures and service standards and have full knowledge of the hotel facilities and happenings

d: We are seeking an experienced IBM APIC & ACE Middleware Developer with a minimum of 7 years of experience in middleware and integration development. The role involves designing, developing, and supporting integration solutions between Murex and banking systems such as Equation, PayHub, and other enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in IBM API Connect (APIC), IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE), IBM MQ, API security, and banking integrations.
Design, develop, and maintain middleware solutions using IBM API Connect (APIC) and IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE).
Develop and manage APIs and integration services between banking applications, digital channels, and third-party systems.
Implement middleware solutions using REST/SOAP services, messaging technologies, and microservices architecture.
Ensure the security, scalability, reliability, and performance of integration platforms.
Develop and support messaging solutions using IBM MQ.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize middleware performance and integration workflows.
Implement CI/CD pipelines and support automated deployment processes.
Collaborate with business, application, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver integration solutions.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, integration specifications, and support procedures.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of experience in IBM middleware and integration development.
Proven experience with IBM APIC, IBM ACE, and IBM MQ.
Experience in banking or financial services integration environments.
Exposure to Murex and other core banking/payment systems is highly preferred.
RESTful APIs and SOAP Web Services
